card.name: Past-tense setting in historical narration
card.fires_on: The word 'had' (also a comma or 'time') right after a subject in past-tense history or biography, where the text is describing what was true or done back then.

modes.label: 'had' after a past subject
modes.description: The word 'had' follows a person, group or thing in a past-tense account, as a main verb or helper.
modes.example: They<< had>> three other siblings: Richard, the eldest

modes.label: Time-setting phrases
modes.description: A comma or 'time' or decade ending that sets up a past period.
modes.example: The finding, at the<< time>>, was hailed as a significant new discovery

card.writes: It pushes toward words like 'upcoming', 'soon' and 'ongoing' and away from Chinese words meaning 'at that time' or 'once was'.
card.plain: It marks spots in historical writing where the text is describing what was the case at some past time.
